capabilities: Restyle Mermaid diagrams using the active theme's background, border, and text colors
Neutralize explicit style and classDef colors so diagrams stay cohesive across themes
Re-theme visible and virtualized diagrams after theme switches without a restart
Normalize flowchart labels and escaped newlines before parsing for better compatibility
Open diagrams in a larger dialog with drag-to-pan and wheel-to-zoom
disambiguation: Not a Mermaid diagram editor or creator; it restyles and views Mermaid blocks already written in notes.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README lists what it does not do yet (per-diagram overrides, per-theme presets) and a roadmap with Style Settings integration and PNG/SVG export.
intentEvidence: makes Mermaid diagrams feel native to whatever Obsidian theme you use
motivation: The author wants Mermaid diagrams to feel native to any theme: "It is no longer tuned for a single theme; the goal is to make Mermaid feel native wherever it is rendered."
problem: Mermaid diagrams in Obsidian keep Mermaid's default colors and small inline size, so they clash with the active theme and wide diagrams are hard to read.

relations.evidence: Patches Mermaid rendering so diagrams are themed at first paint.

summary: Mermaid restyling plugin that makes diagrams match the active Obsidian theme and adds a larger pan and zoom viewer for dense diagrams.
